means: Every board of harddrop's Second Perfect Clear page, parsed from a pinned MediaWiki revision: each board with no grey is a setup placed from empty, each board with grey a four-line Perfect Clear drawn on the setup before it. Quarantined: no claim ids, no badges.

source.terms: not stated; the page credits by link
source.fetched: 2026-10-27, urllib through api.php (formatversion 2); MediaWiki's revision sha1 equals the sha1 of the bytes read
source.definition: To solve 1st PC, you must take 3 pieces out of the 2nd bag. There will then be four leftover pieces, which are usually used in the setup. Since you use six out of the seven pieces out of the new bag to solve 2nd PC, the unused piece is referred to as the "saved piece," and will be the 3rd PC/DPC you go to.

declined.reason: draws next-bag pieces in lower case and some solutions after a line clear, which this transcription's rule (setup from empty, solution = four full rows on it) does not read; not transcribed
